text: Sorry to bother you at this hour, I've got my granddaughter Ellie staying, she's 10. She banged her head on the edge of the kitchen table earlier, cried strait away, poor thing, but she's been completly her normal self since, chattering on and arguing with me about bedtime like always. She was sick the once a bit after but she's kept her drinks down fine since then. Temp is 37.9 I think, the thermometer is an old one so not 100% sure. Also before anyone panics, the purple round her mouth is only blackcurrant squash, she had a big glass of it and it's stained her lips, it does wipe off. I'm just shattered and wanted someone to tell me if I should be watching for anything tonight
